title: Traefik pathname UDS cleanup retains a same-UID final unlink race
summary: The native UDS service revalidates pathname socket identity before cleanup, but POSIX/Linux has no atomic unlink-if-this-inode operation. A hostile process sharing the service UID and directory mutation authority can replace the final pathname after lstat() and before unlink().
summary_de: Der native UDS-Service validiert die Socket-Identität des Pfads vor dem Cleanup erneut, aber POSIX/Linux hat keine atomare Operation „unlink nur bei dieser Inode“. Ein bösartiger Prozess mit derselben Service-UID und Änderungsrecht im Verzeichnis kann den finalen Pfad nach lstat() und vor unlink() ersetzen.
observed_behavior: The current service checks the socket type, owner, device, and inode with lstat(), then calls unlink() by pathname in a later operation. The strengthened double-observation and SO_PEERCRED self-probe close the pre-capture replacement windows, but do not make this final pathname deletion conditional on the previously observed inode.
observed_behavior_de: Der aktuelle Service prüft Socket-Typ, Besitzer, Gerät und Inode mit lstat() und ruft danach unlink() über den Pfad in einer späteren Operation auf. Die verstärkte Doppelbeobachtung und die SO_PEERCRED-Selbstprüfung schließen die Ersetzungsfenster vor der Ownership-Erfassung, machen die finale Pfadlöschung aber nicht von der zuvor beobachteten Inode abhängig.
expected_behavior: A strict foreign-object safety claim requires either no automatic pathname deletion or a verified trust boundary that prevents same-UID directory mutation. It must not claim an unavailable atomic conditional unlink.
expected_behavior_de: Eine strikte Foreign-Object-Sicherheitsaussage erfordert entweder keine automatische Pfadlöschung oder eine verifizierte Trust Boundary, die Same-UID-Verzeichnisänderungen verhindert. Sie darf keine nicht verfügbare atomare bedingte Unlink-Operation behaupten.
impact: The configured 0700 child protects against other UIDs and the current controls fail closed on ordinary replacement. It is not process isolation for a hostile same-UID mutator, so the requested strict no-foreign-socket-cleanup guarantee is not fully proven.
impact_de: Das konfigurierte 0700-Kind schützt gegenüber anderen UIDs und die aktuellen Kontrollen scheitern bei gewöhnlicher Ersetzung geschlossen. Es ist keine Prozessisolation gegenüber einem bösartigen Same-UID-Mutator; daher ist die verlangte strikte No-Foreign-Socket-Cleanup-Garantie nicht vollständig bewiesen.
preconditions: A hostile process shares the service effective UID.
That process can search and mutate the private UDS child directory.
It replaces the pathname in the interval after the final lstat() and before unlink().
reproduction: Inspect traefik_engine_remove_owned_socket(): lstat() validates a pathname entry and unlink() consumes the pathname in a separate system call.
No documented POSIX/Linux unlink API accepts an expected inode, descriptor, or file handle predicate.

evidence.command: TMPDIR=<task-tmp> BUILD_ROOT=<active-run-build> TRAEFIK_ENGINE_SOCKET_TEST_PARENT=<task-tmp> PYTHON=/root/git/ModSecurity-conector/.venv/bin/python MODSECURITY_INCLUDE_DIR=<verified-prefix>/include MODSECURITY_LIB_DIR=<verified-prefix>/lib make -C connectors/traefik test-engine-service

root_cause: Pathname AF_UNIX cleanup uses a check-then-unlink interface. The operating-system API lacks an expected-object predicate for unlink, and the current architecture deliberately uses a same-UID private directory rather than a separately trusted cleanup authority.
root_cause_de: Pfad-AF_UNIX-Cleanup verwendet eine Check-then-Unlink-Schnittstelle. Der Betriebssystem-API fehlt ein Expected-Object-Prädikat für unlink, und die aktuelle Architektur verwendet bewusst ein privates Same-UID-Verzeichnis statt einer getrennt vertrauten Cleanup-Authority.
proposed_remediation: Choose and prove one new boundary: never automatically unlink pathname sockets and surface cleanup_incomplete; use a separately owned trusted cleanup authority; or establish compatible abstract-AF_UNIX support end to end. Do not weaken existing pre-bind collision, identity, or cleanup-refusal controls.
proposed_remediation_de: Eine neue Grenze auswählen und nachweisen: Pfad-Sockets nie automatisch unlinken und cleanup_incomplete ausgeben; eine getrennt besessene vertrauenswürdige Cleanup-Authority verwenden; oder kompatiblen Abstract-AF_UNIX-Support Ende-zu-Ende etablieren. Bestehende Pre-Bind-Kollision-, Identitäts- oder Cleanup-Refusal-Kontrollen nicht abschwächen.
acceptance_criteria: The final cleanup path never claims atomic unlink-if-inode behavior.
Either automatic pathname deletion is disabled fail closed, or an independently verified trust boundary prevents same-UID path replacement.
The existing short-path, collision, symlink, replacement, Allow, Blocking, startup, shutdown, and residue controls remain covered where feasible.
validation_plan: Validate the selected architectural boundary with a real hostile same-UID replacement test.
Run the native C17 engine self-test and protocol lifecycle controls.
Run focused runner contracts and the genuine host lifecycle when its environment becomes available.
regression_tests: A future real same-UID final-unlink boundary test after an architectural solution is selected.
legitimate_control_tests: Normal native engine startup, protocol, Allow, and Blocking controls continue to complete in the focused C service test.
A post-start replacement sentinel is retained and the service reports socket_cleanup rather than deleting it.
dependencies: A user-authorized cleanup trust-boundary decision or compatible abstract-AF_UNIX design evidence.
blocked_by: No current repository-supported atomic conditional pathname unlink or separately owned cleanup authority.
residual_risk: The existing private-child design is appropriate collision mitigation across UIDs, but a same-UID mutator may race the final lstat-to-unlink interval. No risk acceptance has been provided by the current user.
residual_risk_de: Das bestehende Private-Child-Design ist angemessene Kollisionsminderung über UIDs hinweg, aber ein Same-UID-Mutator kann das finale lstat-zu-unlink-Intervall rennen. Der aktuelle Benutzer hat keine Risikoakzeptanz erteilt.

history.detail: The post-bind and post-probe capture windows were hardened and tested, but source-to-sink review confirmed the separate final same-UID lstat-to-unlink pathname limitation. No architectural trust-boundary decision or user risk acceptance was available.
Independent final review kept this final cleanup race separate from FND-PARENT-0014 (manifest leaf removal) and FND-PARENT-0015 (post-readiness Traefik endpoint redirection).
